biggest_catch: Per-receipt kick amounts are tiny and Shopkick's official pages do not publish an exact kick-to-dollar conversion or payout minimum, so the grind to a cashout is real — but the redemption mechanics (kicks -> gift cards, PayPal, or Visa 'immediately' once you have enough) are officially published.
catches: Earning is slow: receipt scans and walk-ins pay small numbers of kicks per action; reaching a redeemable balance takes consistent daily use.

Official Shopkick pages confirm redemption for gift cards, PayPal, or Visa but do not publish an exact kick-to-dollar conversion or a stated minimum — flagged honestly rather than inferred from third-party numbers.
Shopkick's model is ad/marketing-driven: you earn by walking into stores, scanning products, submitting receipts, and making linked purchases — your shopping behavior data is the product.
Reward selection is in-app; availability of specific gift cards varies.

c1.evidence: Shopkick (Trax retail) — real, long-running US rewards app; official shopkick.com and official Google Play listing.

c2.evidence: Official shopkick.com pages plus official Google Play listing describe earning and redemption.

eligibility: US users (13+; under-18 needs parent consent per official terms) with the free Shopkick app; earn kicks by walking into partner stores, scanning products, submitting receipts, and shopping linked offers.
notes: Verified as a live, official payout mechanism: kicks redeem for gift cards, PayPal, or Visa. Exact per-action kick counts and the kick-to-dollar conversion are not published on official pages, so no dollar-per-hour figure is stated — the route is real but low-paying by design. The $5–$25 Amazon gift card range comes from shopkick.com's own article page.

steps: Download the free Shopkick app from the official Google Play listing (com.shopkick.app) or App Store.
Create your free account (13+; under 18 needs a parent's consent per official terms).
Earn 'kicks' in the app: walk into partner stores, scan products in-store, submit receipts, and complete linked shopping offers.
Keep earning until you have enough kicks for a reward — the grind is slow by design.
Open Rewards in the app and redeem your kicks for gift cards (including Amazon $5–$25, per shopkick.com), PayPal, or Visa, 'immediately once you have enough.'
timing: Redeem 'immediately once you have enough' kicks, per the official listing — no published fulfillment clock beyond that.

weasel_words.quote: 'immediately once you have enough' — redemption is instant-ish, but 'enough' hides an unstated balance threshold and an unstated kick-to-dollar conversion.
